Method of Attack: Encrypts files on infected systems, targeting enterprise or government agency networks, encrypting as many computers as possible and demanding large ransoms for decryptors
Encrypts only partial blocks of large files (up to 2,000 blocks of 1,000,000 bytes) to avoid detection
Decryptor bug causes truncation of last byte in large files leading to data loss
Deletes encrypted files after (supposed) successful decryption, complicating recovery
Impacted Systems: Files including databases (e.g., Oracle database files)
Indicators of Compromise: Encrypted files containing 'HERMES' file marker with block count in footer
Attack Vector: Gaining access to networks of enterprises or government agencies, then encrypting files on multiple computers
